confirmed_sample_content: A sample morphology item distinguishes ВСЁ-ТАКИ as a particle.
A sample morphology item treats НЕСМОТРЯ НА in 'продолжал работать, несмотря на усталость' as a preposition.
available_web_fragments.restriction: Sample fragments do not establish the complete Grade-8 denominator and cannot be used to infer chapter coverage.

later_edition_navigation.source: 2025 electronic edition text indexed by Znanium
later_edition_navigation.route_policy: No Grade-8 route may be admitted solely because a topic appears in the later edition. Exact 2018 evidence or project-PDF evidence is required.

gate_rules: Do not reconstruct the Grade-8 contents from memory or from generic Grade-8 curriculum expectations.
Do not transfer a 2025-edition topic into the 2018 school route without exact-edition evidence.
Search-engine snippets from the exact 2018 edition may establish only the literal content they expose; no unseen surrounding rule may be inferred.
Current norm verification remains separate from source-route verification.
Unknown Grade-8 candidates remain NOT_CONFIRMED, not guessed.
No Grade-8 percentage or complete candidate count may be announced while this gate is active.
next_source_actions: Recover exact 2018 table of contents or page text from an accessible exact-edition viewer/index.
Search exact-edition snippets for explicit 'Запомните', 'Исключение', difficult normative forms and contrast tables.
Only after route evidence is recovered, run current-norm review and canonical dedupe.
